name: 97201 · Portland, OR
findings: ZIP 97201 (Portland) has 189 nonprofit organizations. 92 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 80 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97201 (Portland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 97201 (Portland) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
